title: fix(app-shell): grid repeater cells share the card layout's widget-detection path
body:
Fixes #9859

`SchemaForm`'s five name-convention detectors ran in exactly one place — inline in `FieldRow`. `RepeaterField`'s grid/table layout does not go through `FieldRow` (a grid row has no `label` element, so it names each cell from its column header by IDREF instead, objectui#5063) and reached `FieldControl` with `inferWidget` alone, so all five were skipped for every grid cell. `detectSecretWidget` is one of the five, so a repeater that opted into `widget: 'grid'` lost credential masking silently.

---

## FIRST deliverable — is any live surface affected today? **No. Measured, not assumed.**

Triage's grade condition was: *any real metadata declaring a secret field inside a grid-layout repeater (named object + named field) raises this to p1.* The answer is **zero**, and the zero is lit by same-subject controls in the same runs.

**Corpus** — `METADATA_FORM_REGISTRY` of the published `@objectstack/spec@17.4.0` that this repo installs (17 metadata types: object field hook report dataset view app dashboard position action page agent tool skill flow permission email_template), plus that package's shipped JSON Schemas; cross-checked against the 17 `packages/spec/src/**/*.form.ts` sources on `objectstack` `origin/main` `0b31d90fb`. Readings taken 2026-09-18T12:39Z–12:41Z.

The instrument runs the **real** predicate: it copies `SECRET_FIELD_NAME_RE` out of `SchemaForm.tsx` at runtime, refuses to run unless its copy is byte-identical to the source line, and self-tests the predicate (`apiKey` / `client_secret` / `token` / `passphrase` must HIT, `label` / `accessToken` must MISS) before reporting anything.

| reading | result |
|:--|--:|
| **[A] shipped form field specs with `widget: 'grid'` or `widget: 'table'`** | **0** |
| [A-control-1] repeaters in the same corpus carrying no grid widget | **21** |
| [A-control-2] field specs in the same corpus that DO carry a widget | **51** |
| [B] secret-shaped field NAMES in shipped form specs | 0 |
| [C] shipped JSON Schema properties with `format: "password"` | **5** |
| **INTERSECTION — a secret-shaped child of a grid-layout repeater** | **0**, empty because [A] is empty |

[A-control-1] names 21 live repeaters (`dashboard.widgets`, `dashboard.globalFilters`, `view.columns`, `view.sort`, `view.tabs`, `dataset.dimensions`, `dataset.measures`, `action.params`, `action.locations`, `page.regions`, `page.variables`, `page.interfaceConfig.sort`, `report.order`, `report.blocks`, `app.areas`, `flow.nodes`, `flow.edges`, `flow.variables`, `skill.triggerConditions`, `field.options`, `object.fields.options`) — the instrument sees repeaters, and none of them is a grid.

[C] is the other requested control — secret-shaped properties that exist in shipped metadata and are **not** in a grid repeater, by named object and named field: `MongoConfig.password`, `MysqlConfig.password`, `PostgresConfig.password`, `TursoConfig.authToken`, `TursoConfig.encryptionKey`. All five are flat driver config objects rendered through the `dynamic-config` sub-form, not repeater rows.

The same probe over this repo at `a0176176a` finds `widget: 'grid'` in **test fixtures and one comment only**, with `anchors.ts` / `report-schema.ts` lighting the control by carrying real authored widget values (`ref:object`, `icon`, `json`).

⇒ **The asymmetry was latent, not live.** Reported as a reading; this branch does not touch `priority:*`.

---

## The fix shape — one path, not a patched branch

Triage's constraint, quoted in the dispatch:

> ⇒ 交付物应当是**让两条布局共用同一条检测路径**,⛔ 不是在 grid 那侧补一个 `detectSecretWidget`(那样下一个检测器还会漏)。

The chain is lifted out of `FieldRow` whole, into one named `resolveFieldWidget`, and **both layouts call it**. After the change, each of the five detectors has exactly **one** call site, all inside that function, and that function has exactly **two** call sites: `FieldRow` and the grid cell. `inferWidget` likewise drops to one call site.

The lift includes `resolveRegisteredWidget`, which is not scope creep but what makes the lifted chain correct: it turns a conditional widget name into the registration that actually renders (objectui#4871), and `inferWidget` alone already yields `color-picker` for a `type: 'color'` field — so a grid cell that skipped it landed on the swatch `radiogroup` even where the free-colour input was the right face.

No build step is involved — the pin imports `./SchemaForm` source directly, with no dist or alias in the path.

## Acceptance notes

**To file — a reproducible defect this pin surfaced, deliberately NOT fixed here (it is outside the declared file surface; reported rather than widened).** A registered widget declaring `labelling: 'control'` is named by the host's `label` element. A grid/table repeater cell has no label by design (objectui#5063) — it hands the widget a column-header IDREF instead — and a `'control'` widget never reads that IDREF. So any such widget inside a grid cell renders as an **unnamed edit box**.

Measured on this branch, real render, one row: a `type: 'tags'` sub-field resolves to `string-tags` through `inferWidget` **alone** and comes out `id=mdf-rows.0.labels aria-labelledby=null aria-label=null` — so the gap is **reachable today, without this change**. Same signature for the `secret` cell this branch adds (`id=mdf-rows.0.apiKey aria-labelledby=null aria-label=null`), while the `condition` cell, declared `labelling: 'group'`, correctly takes the IDREF (`aria-labelledby=mdf-rows.visible-col`). Across the registry the correspondence is exact: 9 of 20 widgets declare `'group'` and all 9 use `ariaLabelledBy`; 11 declare `'control'` and none of them does.

⇒ This branch **enlarges** that pre-existing population by `secret`, `icon`, `field-ref` and `color-input`. The trade it makes for an `apiKey` grid cell is: masked but unnamed, where before it was named but unmasked. With zero live grid repeaters in shipped metadata (measured above), neither state is reachable on a real page today. Dedupe words: *`labelling: control` widget in a grid cell* · *repeater grid cell has no label element* · *`string-tags` unnamed in a grid row* · *`ariaLabelledBy` ignored by control-labelled widgets* · *objectui#5063 naming channel not reaching the widget*.

*noted, not filed — the pin deliberately does not assert the missing accessible name, because pinning it would freeze the defect; the reason is written into the test beside the assertion that is made. Carrier for the finding above: the seat landing this PR.*

*noted, not filed — this repo's SchemaForm pins are co-located in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` (17 `SchemaForm.*.test.tsx` there, 0 in `packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/`), so the new pin is co-located with its siblings rather than placed in `src/__tests__/` as the dispatch's fence phrased it. Both are inside `packages/app-shell`; no surface was widened.*
